seed_ledger.name: NRG Tolar Power Center (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: plant was to power Sailfish Comanche Circle data center, but NRG withdrew its TCEQ air permit application in June 2026 and Hood County rejected a Comanche Circle settlement October 13, 2026. No supply pipe named in any source. Nearby P3885 Hugh Brinson and P8155 ET Cleburne to Tolar already on roster, no source ties them to this plant. Searches run: 6. Sources: KERA June 2026 (permit withdrawal, no pipe); Texas Public Radio October 2026 (county rejection); Data Center Dynamics on Sailfish (behind-the-meter gas, supplier unnamed).
